title: Community and Infrastructure Services Committee - March 06, 2023

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Community and Infrastructure Services Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 2:01 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Uncollectable Miscellaneous Receivable Accounts Write-Off December 2022, FIN-2023-032
notes:
The Committee considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2023-032, dated January 6, 2023 recommending the uncollectable Miscellaneous Receivable Accounts amounting to $8,781 be written off against the Allowance for Doubtful Receivables.

On motion by Mayor B. Vrbanovic

attachments.name: Uncollectable Miscellaneous Receivable Accounts Write-Off December 2022 - FIN-2023-032.pdf

items.title: Uncollectable Utility Receivable Account Write-Off December 2022, FIN-2023-033
notes:
The Committee considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2023-033, dated January 6, 2023 recommending the uncollectable utility accounts amounting to $80,371 be written off against the Allowance for Doubtful Utility Receivables.

On motion by Mayor B. Vrbanovic

items.title: Drinking Water Quality Management Standard (DWQMS) Re-Endorsement of the Operational Plan, INS-2023-012
notes:
The Committee considered Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2023-012, dated January 18, 2023 regarding the Drinking Water Quality Management Standard (DWQMS) Re-endorsement of the Operational Plan. A. Mick was in attendance and provided a presentation on Discussion Items 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3 and responded to questions from the Committee. 

On motion by Councillor B. Ioannidis

attachments.name: Drinking Water Quality Management Standard (DWQMS) Re-Endorsement of the Operational Plan - INS-2023-012.pdf
Top Management Endorsement of Operational Plan.pdf

items.title: Drinking Water Quality Management Standard (DWQMS): Management Review Summary for 2022, INS-2023-011
notes:
The Committee considered Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2023-011, dated February 2, 2023 regarding the Drinking Water Quality Management Standard (DWQMS): Management Review Summary for 2022. 

On motion by Councillor A. Owodunni

attachments.name: Drinking Water Quality Management System (DWQMS) Management Review Summary for 2022 - INS-2023-011.pdf

items.title: Summary Water Report - 2022, INS-2023-010
notes:
The Committee considered Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2023-010, dated January 19, 2023 regarding receipt of the 2022 City of Kitchener Summary Drinking Water report.

On motion by Councillor C. Michaud

items.title: Information Items
notes: Pursuant to Chapter 25 (Procedure) of the Municipal Code, a motion was brought forward by Councillor A. Clancy to discuss Information item 6.1 listed on the agenda, which was voted on and was Carried.

items.title: Inclusionary Zoning for Affordable Housing: Status Update, DSD-2023-071
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2023-071, dated February 22, 2023 regarding an update to the inclusionary zoning for affordable housing.

Councillor S. Davey entered the meeting at this time.

G. Stevenson, T. Donegani and N. Goss were in attendance and responded to questions from the Committee.

Councillor M. Johnston exited the meeting at this time. Councillor D. Schnider assumed Chair.

Councillor M. Johnston re-entered the meeting at this time.

items.title: Adjournment
notes:
On motion, this meeting adjourned at 2:56 p.m.

Marilyn Mills
Committee Administrator
